scope_and_limits.claim_boundary: These results apply to the named workloads and host; they do not prove Guion is faster than Python for every program or platform.
scope_and_limits.historical_workloads: The previous six-workload installed-release report is retained as historical evidence. Its two parallel-CPU comparisons and 20,000-row JSONL comparison were not rerun in this focused pass.
scope_and_limits.long_trials: Three randomized trials per lane; output correctness checked on each invocation.
scope_and_limits.os_file_cache: Uncontrolled; results are not cold-disk measurements.
scope_and_limits.peak_memory: Not measured because the operating system denied the available sampler; no retry or permission escalation was attempted.
scope_and_limits.platform: This cohort ran on one macOS arm64 host using Python 3.14.7.
scope_and_limits.short_trials: 21 randomized fresh-process pairs per workload; Guion used --no-cache; output correctness checked on each invocation.

peak_memory_observation.reason: The operating system denied the available system memory sampler under this run's permissions.
